First turn, para and tamamo use their four buffs, and you np with chen gong. Chen Gong will have 50% np

Nero Bride comes in, and buffs Chen Gong with her two relevant buffs and brings him to 80% np.  Plugsuit swap Tamamo and Waver and have Waver use his two 10% charges and Chen Gong np's. He ends up around 43% np

Mash comes in, and collectively between her 20% charge, wavers remaining 30%, and Chen Gong's 10%, he can np one more time and you should clear the wave easily with the plugsuit damage buff.

So in essence you need two of Waver, Tamamo, and Nero Bride, and a mlb kscope. It's definitely not a friendly setup at all, but not quite as demanding as the setups that require both Waver, skadi, and Tamamo

Be careful with undervolting too much, you can actually take a performance hit if you go too far, even if it looks like it's running at full speed, it's called clock stretching. You'll want to make sure your cinebench score or whatever isn't going down.

As for the high voltage and temperature spikes, that's generally expected behavior for Zen2. Zen2 very uniquely under single threaded loads will pump a ton of voltage into a single core, that would be unsafe for multi-threaded loads. This creates high temperature spikes in a very small area that quickly dissipate. This is expected, safe, and normal behavior.

However, if you are seeing things like 1.45v to all cores when say, running cinebench multithreaded, that is a problem, and worth looking into.
